# 1.1

Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge release. The version number is now 1.1 so it matches the 26.1.2 port. Gameplay is the same as the previous 0.1.0 build.

## Credits

- Original mod, art, models, sounds, story and characters: **Mokel** – [The Shattered Goddess (Mokel's Bossfight) - Saphyra](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-shattered-goddess-mokels-bossfight-saphyra).
- This port keeps the original assets and story. If you enjoy it, please support the original author.
